record.question: In Mizoram, Administrative Approval for all works under PWD is accorded from the Office of the
record.explanation: Administrative approval is, in the CPWD framework that Mizoram PWD follows (pwd.mizoram.gov.in states State PWD officers are authorised the same financial powers as CPWD officers), the formal acceptance of a project by the administrative department - the Secretary of the works department - while technical sanction of estimates is given by the Engineer-in-Chief and expenditure sanction comes from the Finance Department; the other MPSC JE Civil papers in this series state 'the formal acceptance by the administrative department for incurring an expenditure on the work is called administrative approval'. Mizoram PWD's own Citizen's Charter (EIC, Highways and CE-Roads charters, 2022/2025) confirms the technical wing only 'submits DPR/Estimates to government for administrative approval and expenditure sanction'. No Mizoram delegation order was available to verify the wording for 2016, hence medium confidence.
